description: This pie chart, titled "Statistics of the dataset in our experiments," visually represents the proportional distribution of five distinct dataset components. The chart is divided into five slices, each labeled with its name, percentage, and corresponding count in parentheses. The largest segment, colored red, is labeled "TriviaQA" and accounts for 46% of the dataset (1829 instances). The second largest, a purple slice, is "WebQA" at 25% (997 instances). A green slice represents "HalluEval" at 18% (721 instances). A small yellow slice labeled "Chinese Domain" constitutes 6% (231 instances). The smallest segment, a light blue slice, is "HalluQA" at 5% (185 instances). Each slice is clearly labeled with its name and percentage value, and the chart includes a legend that maps the colors to the dataset names, although the legend itself is not visually distinct from the chart's labels. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left and proceeding clockwise.
